title: Debug a wrong status line
prompt: describe should return "Progress: N%" for a progress update and "Blocked: REASON" for a blocked one. If a blocked update has an empty reason, return "Blocked: no reason given". The code compiles, but some updates get the wrong text. Find the cases that fail, explain why, and fix it.
hints: Try a progress update of 0 percent.
Which values does an if (!value) check treat as missing?
Use the kind tag to choose the branch, then handle the empty reason separately.
checks: describe({ kind: "blocked", reason: "waiting on review" }) === "Blocked: waiting on review"
describe({ kind: "blocked", reason: "" }) === "Blocked: no reason given"

wrongAnswers.misconception: Fixes zero percent but drops the empty-reason rule.

feedback: Zero and empty text are real values. Branch on the tag, not on truthiness.
